newsitem.title: ITALY: Cirio-Bombril group debt 825 bln lire - Cragnotti.
newsitem.headline: Cirio-Bombril group debt 825 bln lire - Cragnotti.

text.p: Sergio Cragnotti, chairman of Italian food processing firm Cirio SpA, said the group comprising Cirio and Brazil's Bombril currently had debt totalling 825 billion lire.
Cragnotti was denying press rumours putting the group debt at 2.2 trillion lire.

"Consolidated debt of the Cirio-Bombril group is 825 billion lire with equity of 1.4 trillion lire," Cragnotti told reporters after a shareholders' meeting which approved the incorporation of Cirio Polenghi De Rica into Cirio SpA.
He added that the Cirio-Bombril group would post 1997 consolidated profit of 50 billion lire.
Brazilian cleaning products maker Bombril took a controlling stake in Cirio earlier this year for $380 million.

Cragnotti said that group turnover in 1998 would exceed 5.0 trillion lire against 3.0 trillion lire in 1997 thanks to a series of accords in many third world and Latin American countries to be concluded in the near term.
